description: Antennes de téléphonie mobile - Orléans Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ANFR. Mobile phone antennas 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G deployed in the territory of Orléans Métropole. Source ANFR. Coverage: Orléans Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Mobile phone antennas – Orléans Métropole" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is ANFR. Its keywords include amenagement-numerique. The listing shows 4 download or service links in ZIP, JSON, CSV. The listing shows 2022-05-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
